source.evidence_level: primary-static unless noted (every VA below disassembled from a verified function prologue; indirect-call targets resolved at call sites)
source.scope: player-character composition: gender byte -> type -> element (M-Hum vs WM-Hum), descriptor struct, frame formulas, element table 0x5600FC (stride 0x144), WIL path slot table (element = slot), overlay draw order/formulas (weapon/body/hair/helmet/horse), render-mode bit semantics, per-frame animation resetter 0x4058E0, M-SHum.wil absence, CreateChr.dat AVI chain (scope-dropped).

conclusion: Player composition is fully closed statically. The appearance descriptor is a dword+4 struct: byte0 = type (0 male / 1 female / 2 odd-reject / 3 monster / 0x32 NPC), byte2 = state/dir (players S<9) or race-lo, byte3 = race-hi, byte4 = riding style. The config dispatcher 0x404FB0 reads the type byte and binds gender to element: type 0 -> [e+0x8C]=0x47 (element 71 = M-Hum), type 1 -> [e+0x8C]=0x4C (element 76 = WM-Hum); the leaf painter 0x405630 repeats the same gender->element binding (0x405673/0x405689) and computes player frames = word[0x8AA5C0+6*flag] + 3000*S + 10*dir ([e+0xB4] base / [e+0xB8] end / [e+0xBC] interval), S = byte2 of the descriptor dword. The element table 0x5600FC (BSS, stride 0x144, entry +4 kind byte dispatching to 0x466640 / 0x466720, +0x38 resolved frame-header pointer) is addressed by element; element index == WIL path slot index (verified for 71/76/87/88/128/131). Overlay composition runs in one draw fn 0x40F5F0: (1) horse pass1 frame = ((frame_base - 3000*S - 0xAA0) mod 400) + 0x2710, (2) weapon pass1 frame = [e+0xC4] + ((sel-1)%10)*3000 - S*3000, (3) body frame = [e+0xC4] with bbox clamp, (4) hair/helmet frame = same weapon formula via [e+0x8B] sel, (5) weapon pass2 + horse pass2 in render-mode-blit passes. Render-mode resolver 0x404DA0 maps flag bits [e+0x61C68] to a mode word. No M-SHum.wil string/literal exists in the EXE (on-disk M-SHum.wil 32722 frames is NOT referenced). Gender->type byte has NO static writers in 0x400000-0x47FFFF (runtime/server-filled via entity build path).
